entry.name: TacWAM Wet-Lab Tasks
entry.title: tacwam-wetlab-tasks
entry.summary: Glove-teleoperated lab-bench manipulation on a UFACTORY xArm6 with a BrainCo Revo2 right hand wearing a Tujian EI-G012 tactile glove (880 taxels over 15 pads), with a static Orbbec RGB-D head camera and a RealSense D405 wrist camera: a cap-to-tray smoke test (53 + 60 demonstrations), 64 tube-rack transfers, further task folders (sorting, whiteboard erasing, dual-arm tube pour) and policy rollouts, behind a Hugging Face gate.
entry.hand: BrainCo Revo2 right hand (6 motors) on a UFACTORY xArm6, wearing a Tujian EI-G012 tactile glove; later folders are named dual-arm

sensor.note: Card: 'Tujian EI-G012 tactile glove (15 pads, 880 taxels)', stored in right_hand_data.npz; every stream is resampled onto one 30 Hz grid with valid/ masks. Native tactile rate, array shape and units not on the public card; files not opened (gated).

scale.text: Counts on the public card: smoke_test 53 cap-to-tray episodes (14,356 action frames, 8.0 min), smoke_test_v2 60 approved cap-to-tray demonstrations, task1 64 tube-rack transfers (53 train / 11 validation), policy rollouts of N0-VTLA (5 of 10 successes reported); task2 (soft/hard sorting), task3 (whiteboard erasing) and four task4 dual-arm tube-pour folders have no counts on the card. Planned task list T1-T5: cup transport, tube to rack, compliance sorting, tool bench cleanup, dry media transfer.

entry.access: Hugging Face SingleBicycle/tacwam-wetlab-tasks; the files open after agreeing to share Hugging Face contact information (gate listed as manual approval).

gate.note: Gate text: 'You need to agree to share your Hugging Face information to access this dataset.' Hugging Face API reports gated: manual.

caveats: No paper or project page; the publisher is a personal account, and the card refers to a collection protocol in an unnamed source repository.
The card's rig section describes only the right arm and right hand, with the left side planned, while the later task4 folders are named dual-arm; whether those use a second gloved hand was not read.
The card gives 635 GB as the total size, while the Hugging Face API reports 176.2 GB of storage on 2026-10-29.
The teleoperation glove does not sense thumb opposition; the card says the vendor SDK synthesizes that motor channel from flexion, and the ring and pinky channels saturate at 1000.
Folder READMEs for task2, task3 and task4 and all data files are behind the gate and were not read.

tracking.note: 6 hand motor channels; arm command loop median 25.4 Hz per the card

sources: https://huggingface.co/datasets/SingleBicycle/tacwam-wetlab-tasks (public card text and gate prompt via the dataset page; repository metadata and top-level listing via the Hugging Face API)
unconfirmed: Tujian = 途见, the Chinese name of Tachin Technology; EI-G is Tachin's glove series and 880 taxels over 15 regions matches the catalog's TachinGlove, so the hardware link rests on the model number and counts.
episodes left null: the card counts only 177 demonstrations in three folders (53 + 60 + 64), and the old 53 smoke-test episodes are reused in the V2 training mix.

The task4_dual_arm_tube_pour_20261005 and _20261022 folders (with failure folders) match the dates of the two batches in rss_dual_arm_tactile by the same account; whether they hold the same files was not checked.

Predecessor repository SingleBicycle/tacwam-pick-up-bottle (gated, 30 pick-up-bottle and 32 cap-grab episodes on the same xArm6 and Revo2 rig) is named on the card; its tactile source is not stated on its public card.
Language instructions in English are listed per task in the card's task table; whether episodes store them was not read.
